title: Boot Run Simulation
statement: Let $S$ be a deterministic Boolean Turing machine, $A$ a nondeterministic Boolean Turing machine, and let the clock loop flag be fixed. For a configuration $c$ of $S$ on a Boolean input and a finite Boolean choice word $w$, suppose $S$ is still running after every $t<|w|$ steps from $c$. Then the host machine run from the boot configuration of $c$ under $w$ equals the boot configuration of the configuration reached by running $S$ from $c$ for $|w|$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration c of S on a Boolean input
S remains in a nonhalting state after every t with 0 ≤ t < |w|
